subject: Novacorp renewal: uplift + new hosted API rate tiers
messages:

Cc: Procurement Team <procure@novacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal inquiry — scale-up and tier questions

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We reviewed usage with our platform team and want to propose a renewal with a higher hosted API commit to match Q1 volume forecasts. High-level ask:

- Move from our current 10M token monthly commit to 30M tokens/month for the 12-month renewal term.
- Introduce a mid-tier rate that gives a 12% price reduction for sustained months >25M tokens.
- Keep a soft-throttle (grace) for burst periods (we expect spikes around product launches).

Procurement copied here — they will need an estimated SOW and pricing table to start the internal approval. Can you share a suggested renewal path (SOW + ops notes) and a recommended soft-throttle policy?

Also, we may need a short ramp period in the first month and a delayed billing start if we close before Dec 1.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of AI Platform | Novacorp
elena.rossi@novacorp.com

Subject: Re: Renewal inquiry — scale-up and tier questions

Elena — really appreciate the clear targets. High level response below; attaching a first-pass SOW and rate matrix for procurement.

Summary proposal (first pass):
- 12-month renewal, 30M tokens/month committed.
- Pricing: base rate X/token for 0–25M, mid-tier rate X*0.88 for 25M–40M, overage billed at sustained overage band.
- Soft-throttle: allow 10% short bursts up to 48 hours per month before degrading to a capped queue; define burst credits that can be consumed and replenished monthly.
- Ramp: first-month prorated commit with an option to apply credits for delayed billing start.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Procurement reviews attached SOW_draft and rate_tiers_matrix.xlsx.
2) I loop in Karthik for the ops/latency constraints and Vanessa for onboarding & runbook.
3) If OK, we push the doc to DocuSign and schedule a 30-minute call to confirm the soft-throttle SLA.

I attached: Novacorp_Uplift_SOW_v1.pdf, rate_tiers_matrix.xlsx

Subject: Re: Renewal inquiry — scale-up and tier questions

Thanks — Karthik from SE here. Quick technical clarifications to include in the MAP/SOW:

- Soft-throttle design: we expose "burst credits" which allow short bursts without impacting latency until credits are exhausted. Credits are consumed per-token and replenish monthly. After credits are exhausted, requests are queued with an SLA-backed max queue wait (30s) before returning a 429 or degraded throughput depending on route policy.
- Mid-tier pricing application: pricing tier is evaluated daily and applied pro-rata at invoice generation. That means if cumulative tokens cross 25M mid-month, mid-tier price will apply to tokens after the threshold (not retroactive to prior consumed tokens). We can change to month-end smoothing if Procurement prefers.
- Ops owner for burst incidents: Vanessa will be primary CS contact; Redwood platform SRE will open a dedicated runbook and contact rota.

I'll attach a one-page MAP draft and a short ops note.

Attachment: MAP_onepage_novacorp.pdf

-Karthik

Elena / Procurement — thanks for the quick back-and-forth. Confirming the path and next steps so we have an auditable trail:

Agreed path (summary):
- Term: 12 months, commit 30M tokens/month starting on billing start date.
- Pricing: mid-tier discount applies to tokens beyond 25M within the billing month, applied pro-rata at invoice generation (as Karthik noted).
- Soft-throttle: 10% burst cushion by default; monthly burst credits (equivalent to 3M tokens) replenish at month boundary. After credits: up to 30s queued with graceful degradation policy or a 429 depending on route.
- Ramp: prorated first-month commit and optional billing deferral to Dec 1 if signed earlier.

Action items:
1) Marcus to send updated SOW (incorporate MAP + SOC2/data-retention language).
2) Elena/procurement to confirm billing start date and internal approver list.
3) I will prepare onboarding runbook and schedule a kickoff (target: 2 business days after SOW signature).
4) Marcus — please route the DocuSign link when SOW is finalized.

DocuSign link placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/rooms/novacorp-uplift-8392
